issue.body:
This is a bug report.

This is a very hard to catch bug, that I have no idea how to reproduce. It happens very sparingly. 
Basically, I have a very simple starlette application that also has a wildcard route registered. 99.99% of the time, the routing works the way I expect, where the specific route (in this case _/csp-reports) goes to the correct function. But occasionally, it goes to the catch all instead. 

Below is an example stack trace

```
ShouldNotBeHere(): Exception in ASGI application
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py", line 375, in run_asgi
    result = await app(self.scope, self.receive, self.send)
 File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/middleware/proxy_headers.py", line 37, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, send)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/applications.py", line 133, in __call__
    await self.error_middleware(scope, receive, send)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/middleware/errors.py", line 177, in __call__
    raise exc from None
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/middleware/errors.py", line 155, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, _send)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/exceptions.py", line 73, in __call__
    raise exc from None
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/exceptions.py", line 62, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, sender)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/routing.py", line 590, in __call__
    await route(scope, receive, send)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/routing.py", line 208, in __call__
    await self.app(scope, receive, send)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/routing.py", line 41, in app
    response = await func(request)
  File "/app/heimdall/core.py", line 30, in catchall
    raise ShouldNotBeHere()
```


My starlette app is this:
```
import json
import os

import uvicorn
from canopy import client
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse

app = Starlette(debug=False)

LOCAL_DEV = os.getenv('IS_LOCAL', 'false').lower() == 'true'


@app.route('/heartbeat', methods=['GET', 'HEAD'])
async def heartbeat(request):
    return JSONResponse({'message': 'bro, we good?'})


@app.route('/_/csp-reports', methods=['POST'])
async def csp_reports(request: Request):
    body = await request.body()
    report = json.loads(body.decode())
    print(json.dumps({'report': 'CSP-REPORT', 'contents': report}))
    return JSONResponse({'message': 'roger roger'})


@app.route('/{path:path}')
async def catchall(request: Request):
    raise ShouldNotBeHere()


def main():
    uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000, http='h11', headers=[('Server', 'heimdall')],
                proxy_headers=True, log_level='warning')
```

Any idea what could be causing the routing to occasionally resolve in a different order?
issue.title: Starlette race condition? on catch all routing
